title: State Park Marina

services.name: Boat Rental
services.desc: Life jackets are provided Free of charge to everyone and are mandatory for kids under 13. Reserve Online for 6-hour, 8-hour, or All-day rentals. 3-hr rentals are available on a walk-in basis, subject to availability. Reservations require a valid credit card to serve as a "No Show" deposit. All rental charges are paid in our store the day of rental. You may cancel a booking up to 72 hours before to avoid a “No Show” fee equal to 1/2 your rental

services.name: Catamaran Tour
services.desc: Get ready to set sail for an unforgettable catamaran cruise and discover Branson’s natural attraction, Table Rock Lake! Join Captain Matt on a Caribbean-style adventure aboard the 48-foot Spirit of America. This ocean-rated vessel, operated by a coastguard-licensed captain and crew, has room for 49 passengers. Bottled water is included; feel free to bring your cooler onboard. Food/beverages are on a bring-your-own basis. Alcohol onboard is limited to beer and wine and is only for those over age 21. Public 2-hour Sail-Swim Cruise at 12:30 pm daily includes large water accessories, a giant water slide, and kayaks. Book online below. Custom Private Charters. Book by emailing Capt. Matt:
